leads.title: Engineering (YC Winter 2017)
leads.posting: Team size: 21. Decentralised broadband connectivity. We enable humans & machines with internet connectivity at a price that they can afford. The inspiration for Wifi Dabba came from the founders working together for the last decade in the mobile application industry and realising the biggest reason for user churn being access to cheap and affordable internet access. From having worked on ground onboarding users and facing poor connectivity issues all the time, we took it on ourselves to fix the internet access problem for the common citizen. At Wifi Dabba (YC W17), we are building a low cost, scalable & distributed Wi-Fi infrastructure to connect next billion users online. We do this by deploying a grid of lasers (Free Space Optics) over the cities & town and bring cheap and fast internet for everyone. We enable anyone to buy 1 gig of data access at a time at a price they can afford. Sachetization of internet access is the foundation to rebuilding internet for all. We do this by leveraging crypto and blockchain to truly make internet infrastructure ownership distributed — our vision is to be connectivity layer for the Web3 world. Hardware, Crypto / Web3, Telecommunications, Consumer, India, South Asia

leads.title: Full Stack Engineer
leads.posting: Helpstir is hiring for Full Stack Engineer: About the Company: Helpstir is India's first AI-powered, location-based philanthropy-tech platform. It connects people who need help with verified NGOs, CSR funders and HNI funders. People who use the platform are called HELPSTiRs. Responsibilities: Build responsive React and TypeScript frontends that work with REST APIs and WebSockets. Write async APIs in Python using FastAPI, with clear separation between application layers. Move reports, emails, webhooks and scheduled cron work into background queues using Celery or Python-RQ on Redis. Design PostgreSQL schemas, manage Alembic migrations and tune slow queries. Package applications with Docker and Docker Compose for local and staging environments. Configure Nginx for reverse proxying, SSL and static files. Use PM2 to run Node services where needed. Requirements: You should also be comfortable with PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, Alembic migrations, Redis, Celery or Python-RQ, Docker and Docker Compose. You should be comfortable working on an Ubuntu or Debian Linux server. Git experience and the ability to write tests with Pytest or Jest are required. Experience with Next.js or Vite, asyncpg, connection pooling, PgBouncer, index tuning, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, task retries, idempotency, dead-letter queues, rate limiting, Flower, multi-stage Dockerfiles, Nginx WebSocket upgrade headers, gzip, PM2, log rotation, Playwright, GitHub Actions CI/CD, RBAC or CORS is useful. This is an in-office role based in Delhi. For queries, contact connect@helpstir.in.
